title: Excavations in Palestine, 1934-5: Bethlehem
author: (round-up; Wellcome expedition, geological section, E. W. Gardner)
location_note: Garden in the highest part of Bethlehem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Elephant bones found at 15 m in a garden while digging for water (1934); geological and palaeontological investigation of Pleistocene clays and gravels. The water pit is modern digging, not an archaeological feature. No eligible feature.
